links.comparator_used: Fairness-regularized loss versus worst-group loss, applied to DNN-based embedding models. The abstract does not describe the baseline without fairness objectives.
links.outcome: Balance between depression classification performance and fairness across gender and race/ethnicity groups
links.effect: Worst-group loss achieved a better balance between performance and fairness. Fairness-regularized loss minimized loss across all groups but performed less effectively. No numbers are given in the abstract.
links.quote: Among fairness-aware techniques for mitigating bias in DNN-based embeddings, the worst-group loss, which is designed to minimize loss for the worst-performing demographic group, achieves a better balance between performance and fairness.

links.comparator_used: Standard prompting without ethical framing in LLM few-shot (N-shot) settings
links.outcome: Gender and race/ethnicity disparities in LLM depression classification
links.effect: Guided prompting with ethical framing helped mitigate gender bias in the 1-shot setting. Neither the prompting strategy nor more shots effectively reduced race/ethnicity disparities. No numbers are given in the abstract.
links.quote: In LLMs, guided prompting with ethical framing helps mitigate gender bias in the 1-shot setting.

design_hint: ethical-framing prompt guardrails and fairness-aware loss for bias mitigation
